# Mission: Reveal Geelooy to Search

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos renews every route in every instant; this mission gives Google a stable vessel for content that currently arrives through living JavaScript.

## User outcome

Make the Geelooy site broadly indexable, with special attention to the primary Heichel reading/road experience, while preserving the existing interactive client behavior.

## Evidence rules

- Inspect real routes, HTML shells, APIs, rewrites, robots, sitemap behavior, and production server code before editing.
- Prefer server-visible canonical HTML for public content over crawler-specific rendering.
- Preserve client-side enhancement after the first meaningful HTML response.
- Do not expose private, draft, authenticated, or moderation-only content.
- Verify with direct HTTP responses and rendered browser behavior.

## Initial work graph

1. Map route ownership and deploy/runtime model.
2. Trace Heichel list, series, post, and Road URLs from browser entry to API data.
3. Audit current title, canonical, description, Open Graph, robots, sitemap, and structured data.
4. Choose the smallest architecture that makes public content present in initial HTML.
5. Implement complete-file changes only.
6. Add sitemap/robots/canonical coverage where absent.
7. Test server HTML without JavaScript and hydrated behavior with JavaScript.
8. Re-read all touched files and close remaining work.
